name: GD Control
description: A mobile-friendly Geometry Dash mod menu with gameplay, editor and utility features including Startpos Switcher.

noclip-enabled.name: No-Clip
noclip-enabled.description: Suppresses normal player deaths for both players. Anticheat spikes and level completion still use the original game logic.

speed-multiplier.name: Speedhack
speed-multiplier.description: Scales gameplay time and FMOD master pitch together.

unlock-icons.name: Unlock Icons
unlock-icons.description: Locally treats every icon as unlocked. Does not write unlocks to your RobTop account.

unlock-colors.name: Unlock Colors
unlock-colors.description: Locally treats all primary, secondary and glow colors as unlocked. Does not write unlocks to your RobTop account.

unlock-practice-music.name: Unlock Practice Music
unlock-practice-music.description: Locally unlocks the Practice Music Sync shop requirement. Enable Practice Music Sync in the in-level pause settings.

startpos-previous-key.name: Previous start position
startpos-previous-key.description: Selects the previous start position in the editor and during playtesting.

startpos-next-key.name: Next start position
startpos-next-key.description: Selects the next start position in the editor and during playtesting.

startpos-include-level-start.name: Include level start
startpos-include-level-start.description: Include the beginning of the level in the start position cycle.
